entities.name: Viewer Devices (Mobile/PC)
entities.rationale: Mobile phone and PC icons at far left; the viewer requests a personalized video and plays the segments. Standalone, not inside any container.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Labeled 'API GATEWAY' icon; first stop for rendering requests, with usage plans and API keys. Standalone.

entities.name: RaaS Frontend Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda icon right of API Gateway; validates rendering request, pushes instructions to SQS and polls the response queue. Standalone.

entities.name: SQS Response Queues
entities.rationale: Two overlapping SQS icons labeled 'SQS' at top; rendering engine responds here and the frontend Lambda pulls the response (playlist link). Standalone.

entities.name: SQS Rendering Jobs Queue
entities.rationale: Lower 'SQS' icon; holds rendering instructions pulled by engine instances. Standalone.

entities.name: EC2 Auto Scaling Group
entities.rationale: Orange auto scaling icon inside the orange box labeled 'EC2 AUTO SCALING'; the box contains this icon together with the Spot instances icon.

entities.name: EC2 Spot Rendering Engine Instances
entities.rationale: White/orange spot instance icon drawn INSIDE the orange 'EC2 AUTO SCALING' box next to the Auto Scaling icon; rendering engines running on Spot instances across multiple AZs and instance types.

entities.name: S3 Video Segments
entities.rationale: Green bucket labeled 'S3'; rendering engine uploads video segments, origin for CloudFront. Standalone.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Labeled 'CLOUDFRONT' icon top-left; serves video segments to the player from the S3 origin. Standalone.

entities.name: Scaling Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda icon above Step Functions; triggered every 15 seconds by Step Functions, consumes CloudWatch metrics and tells the Auto Scaling group to scale. Standalone.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Labeled 'STEP FUNCTIONS' icon; triggers the scaling Lambda every 15 seconds. Standalone.

entities.name: Spot Interruption Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda icon above 'CLOUDWATCH EVENTS' label; notified of spot interruption, calls the instance to drain jobs and detaches it from the ASG. Standalone.

entities.name: CloudWatch
entities.rationale: Large pink CloudWatch icon at bottom right; receives metrics pushed from rendering instances, consumed by the scaling Lambda. Standalone, with small event icon overlapping its top-right corner.

entities.name: CloudWatch Events
entities.rationale: Small light-pink icon labeled 'CLOUDWATCH EVENTS' overlapping the corner of the CloudWatch icon; emits the spot interruption notice event to the Lambda.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow from the devices to API Gateway: rendering request enters RaaS.
Green arrow from API Gateway to the frontend Lambda.
Green arrow from Lambda down to the lower SQS: pushes rendering instructions.
Arrow drawn from the Auto Scaling box pointing to the lower SQS: engine instances pull rendering jobs from the queue.
Green arrow from the Auto Scaling box up to the upper SQS icons: engine responds quickly with the result.
Green arrow from Lambda up toward the upper SQS: the same Lambda invocation polls the response queue.
Curved green arrow labeled 'playlist' from the Lambda area back to the devices: returns the playlist file link.
Green curved arrow from the Auto Scaling box up to S3: rendering engine uploads video segments.
Long green arc from S3 to CloudFront: CloudFront pulls video segments from the origin.
Green curved arrow from the devices up to CloudFront: player requests video segments.
Green curved arrow from Step Functions up to the Lambda: triggers it every 15 seconds.
Green arrow from the scaling Lambda down toward CloudWatch: Lambda consumes the metrics.
Green arrow from the scaling Lambda up to the Auto Scaling box: increases the number of in-service instances.
Green arrow from the Auto Scaling box down to CloudWatch: rendering instances push metrics.
Green curved arrow from the CloudWatch Events icon up to the right-hand Lambda: spot interruption notice.
Green arrow from the right-hand Lambda up to the Auto Scaling box: API call to drain the instance, then detach it from the ASG.
